lines.text: Hello, and welcome to Fel's Voice Lab. Everything you hear was made on a mini PC, using only its processor. No cloud, and no graphics card.
Every voice is one of Kokoro's preset voices. The Lab casts them as characters, directs their lines, and keeps every take.
A scene comes together line by line, and the whole of it exports as one package, with captions and lip-sync tracks.
And every file it makes says, inside it, that the voice is synthetic.
Have a listen, then make it your own.
